full_details: The ink was boiled. The horn was twopence. Titus at two is not yours, and you did not go. The Rose has the first Tamburlaine, and you did not go. The leaf is dated the twenty-seventh of January, 1594, with no name, no number, and no person at the head of it. At a quarter past seven John called from Aldermanbury. He has been through the book with Abel. You have written four ladies and a dairymaid, and he has three boys, and one of the three is the page. You offered to cut the dairymaid. Kemp has already seen her. Two boys out of Pope's parish, three shillings the week each, to stand as Maria and Katharine. Sincler in black for the messenger, since he needs no padding to look like bad news. John takes the schoolmaster. His wife says Nick is growing through his sleeves. He said the Princess wants a gown. You did not send him to buy it. The three shillings are agreed and not paid.
one_sentence: You stayed in, began a leaf, and at night John settled the ladies and kept the dairymaid.
title: Paid for the horn and heard John count the ladies
